name: StepHeroNFTs
fix_description: In claimReferral (0xe61aee51), the function calls func_2D1E to transfer funds BEFORE clearing storage[0x05][sender][token] = 0. This violates checks-effects-interactions pattern. If the transfer triggers a callback (e.g. ETH transfer or NFT onReceived), attacker can re-enter claimReferral while balance is still set. Fix by setting storage to 0 BEFORE the external call.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a multi-step chain involving a PancakeV3 flash loan, interaction with undocumented/protocol-specific StepHeroNFTs functions, deploying helper contracts, and abusing referral/ETH callback behavior to extract value. While the PoC is short, understanding why the low-level call plus nested claimReferral and buyAsset interactions work requires protocol-specific reasoning beyond a trivial bug pattern.
